subject.title: Make agent identity preamble configurable (replace hardcoded 'personal assistant')

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow main-agent identity-line configuration API, and should the canonical shape be the open `identityLine`/`identityMode` design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/82165 or a different prompt identity policy?
rationale: The source-reproducible behavior remains, but AGENTS.md treats new config/default prompt surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product direction rather than an automatic bug-fix cleanup.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in identity-line API
options.body: Use the open candidate PR or a narrowed successor to add a default-preserving identity-line mode with focused prompt-cache and config tests.

options.title: Reject new prompt config
options.body: Close this issue and related implementation attempts with guidance to use existing whole-prompt replacement or external persona files despite their maintenance cost.

options.title: Fold into SOUL.md elevation
options.body: Make the broader SOUL.md/context-elevation issue the canonical design and close this narrower preamble request only after that direction is accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in identity-line API
recommendation.body: Use the open candidate PR or a narrowed successor to add a default-preserving identity-line mode with focused prompt-cache and config tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current-main prompt/config history signal and is the best available owner for the product/API acceptance question.
